tree.heading: Definition of eligible entity
tree.text: In this section, the term “eligible entity” means—

children.text: an 1890 Institution (as defined in section 7601 of title 7);
a part B institution (as defined in section 1061 of title 20) (commonly referred to as “Historically Black Colleges and Universities”);
a tribal college or university (as defined in section 1059c(b) of title 20); or
a Hispanic-serving institution (as defined in section 1101a(a) of title 20).

tree.heading: Grants
tree.text: The Secretary shall make cellulosic ethanol and biofuels research and development grants to 10 eligible entities selected by the Secretary to receive a grant under this section through a peer-reviewed competitive process.

tree.heading: Collaboration
tree.text: An eligible entity that is selected to receive a grant under subsection (b) shall collaborate with 1 of the Bioenergy Research Centers of the Office of Science of the Department.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to make grants described in subsection (b) $50,000,000 for fiscal year 2008, to remain available until expended.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective on the date that is 1 day after Dec. 19, 2007, see section 1601 of Pub. L. 110–140, set out as a note under section 1824 of Title 2, The Congress.
